description: This tenant's document store counters: documents, bytes, text_bytes, the current change watermark, this plan's document/byte quotas, and an index block (mode, indexed_watermark, lag_seconds, pending_documents, chunks, rebuilding, quota_chunks_reached) describing the search index's own freshness.

tenant_key.description: The key `signup` returned. Required only when this connection carries no Authorization: Bearer header -- when both are present, the header wins. Omitting it on a connection with no header returns tenant_key_missing (-32602).
